questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 Electronia Customer Service

New Customer

Thank you for your purchase.

June 9, 10:21 A.M.
Thank you for purchasing a Power Speed printer at Electronia. We hope that you are satisfied with both the printer you bought as well as the customer service you received. If you have any problems with the printer, please contact us via the Internet at our company’s homepage.

Thank you!
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a customer. In your e-mail, describe TWO problems that you have had with the printer and ask ONE question.
questions.model_answer:
To Electronia Customer Service, Lời chào
Thank you for your follow-up on the purchase of my printer. The work I do involves a lot of printing every day, so I had to buy a really good printer this time. Regrettably, I currently have two problems with this printer. I imagined a printer as powerful as the name, Power Speed, suggests. But, this printer has not lived up to my expectations. It takes over 10 seconds to print just a single sheet of paper (vấn đề 1). That is way too slow. The other problem have is that I need to clear paper jams too often (vấn đề 2). I went to your website and found an upgraded version of this printer. Can I exchange my printer for that one (câu hỏi)? Please e-mail me if there are any reasons why I would not be able to make an exchange. Mở đầu: Giới thiệu rằng công việc phải in nhiều, nên mong muốn có một chiếc máy in tốt. Nhưng lại có 2 vấn đề không như mong muốn. Vấn đề gặp phải với máy in: - Tốn mất 10 giây để in một tờ giấy - Hay bị kẹt giấy Câu hỏi: - Liệu tôi có thể đổi máy in sang loại máy in được cải tiến hơn không?
Regards, Emily Jones Ký tên

questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 SMD Ltd.

Tom Parker, payment officer, Techtonia Solution

Overdue Payment

May 23rd, 4:32 P.M.
Dear Mr. Parker,

I am writing to let you know that we have not received payment for the orders you made 2 months ago. We were in agreement that the payment would be received by March 20th, but it has not arrived. Please send it as soon as possible to avoid any delays when re-ordering items. I’m looking forward to receiving your early reply.
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are Tom Parker. In your e-mail, make an apology and ask TWO questions about the overdue payment.
questions.model_answer:
To SMD Ltd., Lời chào
I've just received your e-mail dated May 23 concerning the overdue payment. This e-mail is to address the issue of the overdue payment for the orders made 2 months ago. Not sending the payment by the agreed-upon date, March 20th, was totally my fault. The payment was so large that we couldn't prepare the whole amount. Please accept my sincere apologies. By the way, there are two things that I would like to check about the payment. First, even though a few days have already passed since the deadline, will you still accept the same amount of payment that we initially agreed upon? Second, would you be able to take a post-dated check instead of a cash wired? Once again, I am sorry for the delay in payment. Xin lỗi: - Giải thích rằng tiền quá nhiều nên chưa chuẩn bị kịp - Xin lỗi Câu hỏi: - Liệu bạn có chấp nhận khoản tiền như chúng ta đã đồng ý từ đầu không? - Bạn có thể nhận séc ghi ngày sau thay vì chuyển khoản bằng tiền mặt không
Sincerely yours, Tom Parker Ký tên

questions.question: People have their own preference when choosing companies. Some would like to work for big companies whereas others choose to work at smaller ones. In your opinion, which is the best place to work? Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinions.
questions.model_answer:
Mở bài People have different preferences when it comes to the size of a company they want to work at. Some people like to work for large companies offering relative job security, and others prefer smaller ones for the increased opportunities for promotion. I have experience working for both types of companies, and my preference is for the smaller one. - Làm việc ở công ty lớn có lợi ích là an ninh công việc tốt. Làm việc ở công ty nhỏ sẽ có cơ hội thăng tiến cao - Lựa chọn ưu tiên công ty nhỏ hơn
Thân bài 1 (Công ty lớn) A large company has many merits, like a secure job and competitive compensation. First of all, when a company is big, chances are the company will be in business for a long time, which, in turn, gives job security; unless, of course, an employee fails to achieve a certain standard of work performance. Second, people working for a big company tend to receive better remuneration and benefits than those working at a smaller company. Các lợi ích của làm việc ở công ty lớn: - Có cơ hội làm việc dài hạn -> an ninh công việc tốt - Thù lao và phúc lợi tốt hơn các công ty nhỏ
Thân bài 2 (Lợi ích 1 của làm việc ở công ty nhỏ) However, even with these attractive advantages, I believe employees in a small company have more opportunities. There are also some benefits when working for a smaller company. First, increasing one's chances for promotion is quite easy in a smaller firm. In my father's case, he has been working at a smaller company for ten years. He has been promoted nearly every year, so now he is the vice president of the firm. This type of quick climbing of the corporate ladder wouldn't be possible in a big company - Có nhiều cơ hội hơn: Cơ hội thăng tiến dễ dàng hơn ở doanh nghiệp nhỏ - Ví dụ: Bố tôi làm ở công ty 10 năm, năm nào cũng được thăng chức và đã trở thành phó chủ tịch công ty.
Thân bài 3 (Lợi ích 2 của làm việc ở công ty nhỏ) Second, workers in a small company have a chance to understand how the company actually works. This is because small companies normally have a simple organizational system. When I worked as a sales representative in a small company of 20 employees, I learned lots of things related to business strategies, because I was able to know how all the departments in the company work in perfect harmony with each other. Later, my previous work experience in a smaller firm was very valuable when it comes to running my own business Có cơ hội được hiểu cách công ty vận hành - Phân tích: Bởi vì công ty nhỏ có bộ máy vận hành đơn giản - Ví dụ: Khi tôi làm nhân viên bán hàng cho một công ty nhỏ có 20 nhân viên, tôi đã học được nhiều thứ về chiến lược kinh doanh, bởi vì tôi được biết về cách mà tất cả cách bộ phận trong công ty kết hợp làm việc với nhau. Về sau khi tôi mở doanh nghiệp thì đây là một trải nghiệm quý giá.  
Kết bài Lots of people want to work for a big company due to the advantages mentioned above; however, it may be a better idea to work in a small company, which has great possibilities to climb the corporate ladder and to get more opportunities learning the specifics of how business really works. If I were given a choice between a big or small company, I would choose the small one. Tổng hợp, nhắc lại về lợi ích của làm việc tại công ty nhỏ

intro.content:
Question 1-5: Write a sentence based on a picture

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write ONE sentence that is based on a picture. With each picture, you will be given TWO words or phrases that you must use in your sentence. You can change the forms of the words and you can use the words in any order. Your sentences will be scored on

  • the appropriate use of grammar and
  • the relevance of the sentence to the picture

In this part, you can move to the next question by clicking on Next. If you want to return to a previous question, click on Back. You will have 8 minutes to complete this part of the test.

Example

 Sample response: This man is writing in a notebook.

Question 6-7: Respond to a written request

Directions: In this part of the test, you will show how well you can write a response to an e-mail.

Your response will be scored on

  • the quality and variety of your sentence,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 10 minutes to read and answer each e-mail

Click on Continue to go on.

Question 8: Write an opinion essay

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write an essay in response to a question that asks you to state, explain, and support your opinion on an issue. Typically, an effective essay will contain a minimum of 300 words. Your response will be scored on

  • whether your opinion is supported with reasons and/or examples.
  • grammar,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 30 minutes to plan, write, and revise your essay.

Click on Continue to go on.
